The menu is a planning tool, not a hold on a jar. If one flower listing is the reason you rode in, call 289-206-1181 and ask whether that name is still on the board.

Inside the store, ask for the section you already reviewed: exotic, premium, or another listed flower tier, or a different category such as edibles or vapes. Staff can help you match the live-menu names to the labelled products in front of you. That is the simplest way to finish a trip that started at Brampton GO.
If you are meeting someone, send them the Hillcrest address rather than “the Brampton dispensary.” Queen Street West is Blouds. Hillcrest and Kennedy is Kennedy Loud.
